```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment  = "#>",
  eval     = nchar(Sys.getenv("MOSPI_KEY")) > 0
)
api_key <- Sys.getenv("MOSPI_KEY")
options(cli.progress_show_after = Inf)
```

The mospiR package downloads survey microdata from the [MoSPI Microdata Portal](https://microdata.gov.in).
This portal is the data repository of the National Statistics Office (NSO) of India.
The package uses the NADA API of the portal.
The package sends your API key, reads all the pages of results, and tries a failed request again.

## Installation

```{r install, eval=FALSE}
# CRAN
install.packages("mospiR")

# Development version
remotes::install_github("saketkc/mospiR")
```

## API key

1. Register at <https://microdata.gov.in>.
2. Copy your key from **My Profile → API Key**.
3. Add the key to `~/.Renviron`:

```
MOSPI_KEY=your_key_here
```

4. Run `readRenviron("~/.Renviron")` or start R again.

```{r key-env}
library(mospiR)
api_key <- Sys.getenv("MOSPI_KEY")
```

## Listing datasets

`list_datasets()` gets all the pages and gives one data frame.
To find datasets by title, use the `query` argument.
The package compares `query` with the titles on your computer.
The function ignores the difference between upper case and lower case letters.

```{r list-all}
datasets <- list_datasets(api_key)
cat("Total datasets:", nrow(datasets), "\n")
head(datasets[, c("idno", "title")], 6)
```

```{r search}
plfs <- list_datasets(api_key, query = "labour force")
plfs[, c("idno", "title")]
```

## Listing files in a dataset

```{r list-files}
files <- list_files("DDI-IND-NSO-ASI-2019-20", api_key)
files[, c("name", "size")]
```

## Downloading files

`download_file()` writes one file to `folder_path`.
The function gives the local path of the file as an invisible value.

```{r download-file, eval=FALSE}
path <- download_file(
  dataset_id  = "DDI-IND-NSO-ASI-2019-20",
  file_name   = "ASI_DATA_2019_20_CSV.zip",
  folder_path = "data/asi-2019-20",
  api_key     = api_key
)
```

`download_dataset()` downloads all the files in the dataset:

```{r download-dataset, eval=FALSE}
paths <- download_dataset(
  dataset_id  = "DDI-IND-NSO-ASI-2019-20",
  folder_path = "data/asi-2019-20",
  api_key     = api_key
)
length(paths)
```

If the file name is not correct, `download_file()` shows the names of the available files.
Give the result of `list_files()` in `.files_cache`. Then the function does not get the file list again.

```{r download-missing}
result <- download_file(
  "DDI-IND-NSO-ASI-2019-20", "nonexistent.csv",
  tempdir(), api_key,
  .files_cache = files
)
```

## HCES rounds

The portal has all the rounds of the Household Consumer Expenditure Survey (HCES).
To get all the rounds, do these steps:

1. Find the HCES datasets by title.
2. Download each dataset in a loop.

```{r hces-find}
hces_all <- list_datasets(api_key, query = "consumer expenditure")
cat("Matching datasets:", nrow(hces_all), "\n")
hces_all[, c("idno", "title")]
```

```{r hces-download, eval=FALSE}
for (id in hces_all$idno) {
  download_dataset(id, file.path("data", "hces", id), api_key)
}
```
